scripts.lint: pnpm run package-boundaries:check && pnpm run typescript-exceptions:check && eslint scripts tests eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0 && turbo run lint
scripts.unit: turbo run unit && vitest run tests/workspace/quality-scripts.spec.mjs tests/workspace/toolchain-guard.spec.mjs tests/workspace/all-tests-workflow.spec.mjs tests/workspace/required-cases.spec.mjs tests/workspace/package-boundaries.spec.mjs tests/workspace/typescript-exceptions.spec.mjs
scripts.test:integration: bash scripts/run-profile.sh dev -- vitest run tests/config tests/contracts tests/infra tests/milestones
scripts.test:runtime-smoke: bash scripts/run-profile.sh dev -- vitest run tests/runtime/real-stack.e2e.spec.ts
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @on-the-road/database run build && node packages/database/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:status: pnpm --filter @on-the-road/database run build && node packages/database/dist/cli.js status
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @on-the-road/database run build && node packages/database/dist/cli.js seed
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter @on-the-road/maplibre-spike run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @on-the-road/maplibre-spike run test:visual && pnpm --filter @on-the-road/pdf-spike run test:visual
scripts.test:all:dev: pnpm run unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:visual && pnpm run ci:smoke
scripts.quality: pnpm run test:cases:verify && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run unit && pnpm run build
